The International Centre for Theoretical Sciences of the Tata Institute of Fundamental Research (ICTS-TIFR), a premier research centre (an Autonomous, Grant-in-Aid Institution of the Department of Atomic Energy, …Postdoctoral Researcher position under the project "Monsoon Mission" supported by the Ministry of Earth Sciences (MoES).

This project aims to identify oceanic eddy-wave-topography interactions and the turbulent dynamics leading to energy transfer from large forcing scales to small dissipative scales. The research will be interdisciplinary …

Essential qualification:

Candidates with a PhD from a recognized university in Atmosphere-Ocean Science/Applied and Computational Mathematics/Engineering/Physics/similar related disciplines. Candidates with a provisional degree certificate and …

Desirable qualifications and experience:

  1. Experience working with high resolution numerical simulations in HPC environments along with big data management.

  2. A strong foundation in fluid dynamics, geophysical fluid dynamics, physical oceanography, or related disciplines.

  3. One or more published papers in refereed journals focusing on atmosphere-ocean-climate, fluid dynamics, applied and computational mathematics, or related disciplines.

House Rent Allowance (HRA): The postdoctoral candidate is eligible for Housing Rent Allowance (HRA) as per norms.

Medical Benefits: The postdoctoral will be entitled to medical benefits as per norms.

How to Apply: Interested candidates must apply via the current ICTS postdoctoral hiring cycle (https://www.icts.res.in/academic/postdoctoral-fellowships) and choose Fluid Dynamics and Turbulence as their area of interest. Applicants should indicate their interest by ticking the question 'Would you like to be considered for the Postdoctoral Researcher position under the Monsoon Mission project' in the application portal. Please ensure that you upload the following documents (in a single PDF file) while applying online:

  1. Cover letter expressing interest in this position and explaining how the applicant is a good fit for the position advertised.

  2. Curriculum Vitae (CV) detailing the academic path, relevant graduate courses, research projects, and academic achievements.

  3. Research statement detailing the applicant's research background and previous research projects.

  4. Copies of one or two papers/pre-prints based on the applicant's previous research.

  5. A sample code written in a programming language of the applicant's choice. This code must be well commented and should demonstrate the applicant's proficiency in writing codes. Codes may be in Python, C, Fortran, etc.

In addition to the above, the applicant must arrange two recommendation letters for this position.

Application Deadline: 30 November 2026, 5:00 PM IST

See application procedure details at: https://www.icts.res.in/academic/postdoctoral-fellowships

The initial appointment will be for a period of one year, with renewal up to two more years subject to competitive performance and continuing project funding.
